contracts_signed_requires_signature.name: contracts_signed_requires_signature
contracts_signed_requires_signature.value: "contracts"."status" <> 'signed' OR ("contracts"."specialist_signature" IS NOT NULL AND "contracts"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL)

service_requests_duration_pair.name: service_requests_duration_pair
service_requests_duration_pair.value: ("service_requests"."duration_value" IS NULL) = ("service_requests"."duration_unit" IS NULL) AND ("service_requests"."duration_value" IS NULL OR "service_requests"."duration_value" > 0)

service_requests_content_required.name: service_requests_content_required
service_requests_content_required.value: "service_requests"."service_name" IS NOT NULL OR (cardinality("service_requests"."service_types") > 0 AND "service_requests"."activity_description" IS NOT NULL)
